caption: The video showcases a close-up dominated by a large, smooth blue sculptural form made of flowing ribbon-like curved surfaces that fill the left and center of the frame. At the right edge a thin dark stick angles up-right toward a small upright flame burning at its tip, casting a faint round orange glow onto the blue surface just below the bright flame. Throughout the video the flame flickers. Its height, lean and bright core shift, becoming more rounded while the stick tip near it darkens. The orange spot on the blue surface persists in roughly the same location with only minor intensity variation. The blue sculpture's shape, highlights and position relative to the frame edges stay essentially unchanged, and the stick's overall angle and position also largely remain constant. The camera framing appears fixed, with no obvious pan, tilt or zoom supported by the visible background detail.
relations: Flickering flame shifts its height, lean, and bright core, rounding the flame while darkening the nearby stick tip.
The orange glow cast onto the blue surface persists in roughly the same location with only minor intensity variation.
The blue sculpture's shape, highlights, and position relative to the frame edges remain essentially unchanged.
The stick's overall angle and position stay largely constant under a fixed camera framing.
